info.brief: Functions and constants for interacting with Poki SDK APIs
info.description: Functions and constants for interacting with Poki SDK APIs

elements.name: poki_sdk.gameplay_start
elements.description: Signals that gameplay has started.

elements.name: poki_sdk.gameplay_stop
elements.description: Signals that gameplay has stopped.

elements.name: poki_sdk.commercial_break
elements.description: Requests a commercial break. The callback reports START if an ad starts and SUCCESS when Poki's commercial-break promise resolves.

elements.name: poki_sdk.rewarded_break
elements.description: Requests a rewarded break. The size argument is optional and defaults to small. Call it as rewarded_break(callback) or rewarded_break(size, callback).

parameters.name: size
parameters.doc: Optional reward size. Accepted values are small, medium, and large. Defaults to small.

elements.name: poki_sdk.set_debug
elements.description: Enables or disables Poki SDK debug mode.

elements.name: poki_sdk.capture_error
elements.description: Captures and reports an error to Poki.

elements.name: poki_sdk.is_ad_blocked
elements.description: Deprecated: Poki no longer exposes ad-block detection. This compatibility function always returns false.

elements.name: poki_sdk.shareable_url
elements.description: Generates a shareable URL with the supplied parameters.

parameters.name: params
parameters.doc: String or number values to include in the generated URL.

elements.name: poki_sdk.get_url_param
elements.description: Returns the URL parameter value provided by Poki. The Defold bridge maps a null or undefined result to nil.

returnvalues.name: value
returnvalues.doc: The parameter value, or nil when the Poki result is null or undefined.

elements.name: poki_sdk.measure
elements.description: Sends a custom analytics event to Poki. Use start/complete/fail for progress, visible/interact for offer and UI engagement, or a custom action for other events. Do not duplicate commercial or rewarded ad playback and outcomes; Poki tracks those through the ad calls. The binding defaults omitted `what` and `action` to empty strings for compatibility.

parameters.name: what
parameters.doc: Optional event subject. Defaults to an empty string when omitted.

parameters.name: action
parameters.doc: Optional event action. Defaults to an empty string when omitted.

elements.name: poki_sdk.move_pill
elements.description: Moves the Poki pill to a different vertical position.

parameters.name: topPercent
parameters.doc: Position from the top in percent.

elements.name: poki_sdk.get_user
elements.description: Retrieves the currently logged-in Poki user.

fields.name: user
fields.doc: A table with username and avatar_url, or nil if no user is logged in.

fields.name: error
fields.doc: The rejection message, or nil if the request completed normally.

elements.name: poki_sdk.get_token
elements.description: Retrieves the Poki auth token for the currently logged-in user.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: The short-lived Poki auth token, or nil if no user is logged in.

fields.name: error
fields.doc: The rejection message, or nil if the request completed normally.

elements.name: poki_sdk.login
elements.description: Prompts the player to log in to their Poki account.

fields.name: success
fields.doc: `true` if the login promise resolved, otherwise `false`.

fields.name: error
fields.doc: The rejection message on failure, or nil on success.

elements.name: poki_sdk.open_external_link
elements.description: Opens an external link in a new browser tab for user-initiated external navigation.

elements.name: poki_sdk.COMMERCIAL_BREAK_SUCCESS
elements.brief: A commercial break finished or did not display.
elements.description: A commercial break finished or did not display.

elements.name: poki_sdk.COMMERCIAL_BREAK_START
elements.description: A commercial break started.

elements.name: poki_sdk.REWARDED_BREAK_ERROR
elements.brief: A rewarded break failed or the reward should not be granted.
elements.description: A rewarded break failed or the reward should not be granted.

elements.name: poki_sdk.REWARDED_BREAK_SUCCESS
elements.brief: A rewarded break completed and the reward may be granted.
elements.description: A rewarded break completed and the reward may be granted.

elements.name: poki_sdk.REWARDED_BREAK_START
elements.description: A rewarded break started.
